paragraphs.text: They confess that God's free mercy was the cause of their deliverance because he loved the land which he had chosen.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: You have buried them that they will not come into judgment.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Not only in withdrawing your rod, but in forgiving sins, and in touching our hearts to confess them.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: As in times past they had felt God's mercies, so now being oppressed by the long continuance of evil, they pray to God that according to his nature he would be merciful to them.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He confesses that our salvation comes only from God's mercy.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: He will send all prosperity to his Church, when he has sufficiently corrected them, also by his punishments the faithful will learn to beware that they not return the same offences.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Though for a time God thus exercises them with his rods, yet under the kingdom of Christ they should have peace and joy.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: Truth shall spring out of the

paragraphs.text: Justice will then flourish and have free course and passage in every place.
